title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Compromise Microsoft 365 Tenants
summary: ConnectWise on Saturday said it has disabled seven ConnectWise application identities as it continues its investigation into an incident in which unknown threat actors obtained unauthorized access to the application identities and compromised Microsoft 365 tenants.

title: Hackers exploit SiteGuard WAF flaw to run commands as admins
